原因是原代码在 `mark_paid()` 之前发送通知，而且发送操作位于重试循环中。每次写入失败都会先发出通知，重试成功后便产生重复通知；所有尝试失败时也会错误发送通知。

import unittest
from checkout import Checkout, MemoryNotifications, MemoryStore, TransientStoreError


class CheckoutTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_successful_payment(self):
        store, notifications = MemoryStore(), MemoryNotifications()
        Checkout(store, notifications).pay('order-1')
        self.assertTrue(store.is_paid('order-1'))
        self.assertEqual(notifications.sent, ['order-1'])

    def test_transient_failures_retry_payment_and_notify_once(self):
        for failures in (1, 2):
            with self.subTest(failures=failures):
                store = MemoryStore(failures=failures)
                notifications = MemoryNotifications()

                Checkout(store, notifications).pay('order-1')

                self.assertTrue(store.is_paid('order-1'))
                self.assertEqual(store.attempts, failures + 1)
                self.assertEqual(notifications.sent, ['order-1'])

    def test_exhausted_retries_leave_order_unpaid_without_notification(self):
        for failures in (3, 4):
            with self.subTest(failures=failures):
                store = MemoryStore(failures=failures)
                notifications = MemoryNotifications()

                with self.assertRaises(TransientStoreError):
                    Checkout(store, notifications).pay('order-1')

                self.assertEqual(store.attempts, 3)
                self.assertFalse(store.is_paid('order-1'))
                self.assertEqual(notifications.sent, [])

    def test_already_paid_order_is_a_noop(self):
        store, notifications = MemoryStore(), MemoryNotifications()
        checkout = Checkout(store, notifications)
        checkout.pay('order-1')
        store.failures = 3

        checkout.pay('order-1')

        self.assertTrue(store.is_paid('order-1'))
        self.assertEqual(store.attempts, 1)
        self.assertEqual(store.failures, 3)
        self.assertEqual(notifications.sent, ['order-1'])

    def test_notification_observes_paid_order(self):
        store = MemoryStore()
        paid_when_notified = []

        class ObservingNotifications(MemoryNotifications):
            def send(self, order_id):
                paid_when_notified.append(store.is_paid(order_id))
                super().send(order_id)

        notifications = ObservingNotifications()
        Checkout(store, notifications).pay('order-1')

        self.assertEqual(paid_when_notified, [True])
        self.assertEqual(notifications.sent, ['order-1'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
